note: Act 2 farm slices per class in the shape of levelplan/3 slices (same field names) as a separate file because internal/levelplan has no Act 2 AREAMON rows and the Normal spine has no Act 2 chapters yet (so no quest slices). Entries, exits and life gates are SME ballpark (S, from memory, unsourced) or the quest legacyFloor rows (V data/questboard/act2.json); nothing ran live; every number is U until the margin model or a seed set moves it (docs/process/threshold-governance.md). Class keys are data: the loader and tests never name a class.

tags.entry/exit: S SME ballpark 2026-11-26, not extracted from levels.txt; U live
tags.min_max_life: S SME (Pal 220+ before tombs and Duriel, Sor 150+); lower rows interpolated, U
tags.kit: I, same as the admission road rows
tags.merc: V code: internal/merc ReviveCost, internal/quest Act2Merc; rows U live

merc.note: hire at the first Lut Gholein visit; the aura pick is advisory, hireling.txt must be read at the hire screen (docs/act2.md); revive price min(int(lvl^2/2)*15, 50000) from internal/merc.ReviveCost

barbarian.tag: S: melee archetype with the paladin's entries and exits (same legacyFloor rows).
